formula: offense weight * historical offensive index + defense weight * historical defensive index
aggregation: Combines historical indices covering identical eligible seasons.
scaling: Existing index scales; no additional standardization.
comparisonGroup: Same latest recorded NHL position; eligible matched histories.
percentileMethod: Midpoint percentile for ties using unrounded core indices.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal.
missingDataPolicy: Missing, mismatched and ineligible histories remain ungraded. Missing category weights are not redistributed.
exclusions: No discipline, faceoff, physicality or availability contribution.
interpretation: Provisional positional performance composite, not goals or wins contributed, contract value or projected ability.
limitations: Component scales differ. Defensive inputs retain team and deployment effects. Review sample is diagnostic, not independent validation.
